quest.title: Food From Afar
quest.description: While the clothes are being made, Ayaka suggests that you and Paimon come with her to Kiminami Restaurant to dine.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x475, Mora x31125, Unknown Item #363311 x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: The Whispers of the Crane and the White Rabbit

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we here? Ooh, it's one of those streetside places! Looks cute and cozy!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Miss Kiminami, how do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Aha, Miss Kamisato! Perfect timing. Your booking was for... Well, right now!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I believe so.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: We'll be sticking to the order I placed in advance. As for the other matter we discussed... Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Excellent, no problem. And everything you asked for is ready and waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, tiny customer, please wait here for a moment while I prepare your food.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Go ahead and take a seat. There's something I need to take care of, but I'll be back momentarily.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ahem... It's nothing of that sort.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I just have a few minor things I need to attend to. I won't be long.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She sure left in a hurry... Whatever it is, it must be pretty urgent.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: So, you two are Miss Kamisato's friends?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Haha, well, we serve all the classics. Sure, there are fancier-looking places out there, but the food here speaks for itself! Hope you enjoy it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Over the years we've been in business, we've gotten to know the Kamisato Clan quite well.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Miss Kamisato and her brother are both fond of our food. They're always sending staff down here to order something and take it back to them.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Her table booking surprised me — not least because it was a group reservation! This is the first time I've ever heard of Miss Kamisato going out for dinner with friends!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The first time ever!? Whoa... Guess that makes us pretty important people, huh!

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Sure does, and I'm probably crossing the line here, but... I'm just telling you what others have told me. Apparently, Miss Kamisato doesn't have a lot of friends.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...That really surprises me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How is that possible? She's so kind and polite to everyone, Paimon would've thought that would make her really popular.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: That's what I used to think, too. But it turns out the rules of social interaction are a bit more complicated than that.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Nobody in the neighborhood has a bad word to say about her. They all say she's beautiful, elegant, graceful, not to mention that she belongs to one of the most illustrious clans in the land. In short, they see her as a model young lady.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: But that's just it — people look at her and see a model of perfection, and they don't feel like that's something they can relate to. So the majority of kids from ordinary families don't dare even try to talk to her.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: So you see? On paper, she sounds like a girl everyone would want to get to know, but in practice, she finds it difficult to make friends...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, Paimon never would have guessed...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: We don't speak all that much, but we do go quite a way back. I've always admired her for taking on so many responsibilities at such a young age.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: So it makes me really happy to see her here with friends today!

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Anyway — relax, enjoy your meal, and... please talk to her as much as possible. I know she'll appreciate it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Consider it a favor for the whole neighborhood... Look after her for us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? That sounded like Ayaka...!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: *sigh* I'm so sorry, Traveler...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Could you join me over there for a minute? Um... I need your help with something.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I'm sorry! I didn't want to drag you away all of a sudden... I, um... just had a cooking catastrophe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, so that loud noise we heard came from the cooking pot...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: As you can see, this house is right next to the restaurant. It's where the owner lives.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Actually, this whole compound is the family's private property. I asked Miss Kiminami to prepare some ingredients and utensils for me so that I could cook a special dish here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why would you be cooking?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! If there's something you wanna eat, you could just order it from the menu!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Actually... I wanted to cook something as a gift for Tsubaki.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: My mother mentioned in her notebook that Tsubaki enjoys food from all over the world.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: So I thought, if I'm going to meet Tsubaki, perhaps a dish from overseas would make a fitting gift...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A dish from overseas? So anything from outside Inazuma counts, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If so... then we've got lots of options, don't we?

choices.text: Actually... I'm a bit of a pro in the kitchen.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: That's what I was thinking! You must have picked up a lot of knowledge about different cultures on your travels, hopefully including regional cuisines...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Can I leave you to finish this task, then? Just as a personal favor... I—Is that okay...? I'll be indebted to you!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Great! But... what kind of overseas dish would make a suitable gift? It needs to survive a journey from the kitchen to the recipient's doorstep...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon knows! There's one dish out there that was practically created for this purpose!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pizza~!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: ..."Pizza"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's an assortment of toppings and sauce spread over a bread base and cooked in the oven. And it's so good!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: ...That does sound pretty good.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Is it possible to add some of Inazuma's local flavor to this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No problem! Pizza is almighty!

choices.text: You could say my food is out of this world.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't make this weird!

choices.text: Is it a fight? Do you need backup?

talks.objective: Give the pizza to Kamisato Ayaka

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's ready!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here it is.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: *sniff* It smells delicious... You're an excellent cook, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: *sigh* I would love to be able to master dishes from all over the world...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, all you need to learn is a recipe. We can bring you some more recipes in the future, if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Great! I look forward to learning from your culinary expertise.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: How are you all doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Whoa, is this...? Miss Kamisato, this must be the dish you were talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, an overseas dish cooked by the Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to package it for me?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Ooh, it smells good! I bet it tastes amazing. Aw, now I really want to put something like this on our menu...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, want us to teach you how to make it?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh! Could you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure could.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The most satisfying meals are the ones you share with other people. So Paimon thinks that our friends in Mondstadt wouldn't mind us sharing this dish with Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Really? Aw, that's great, I've always wanted to learn how to cook some international dishes!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: If you can write down a recipe for me, I'll add it to our menu and put a promotion where everyone will see it!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Since we became a closed nation, people haven't had the chance to try anything new. Traveler, you're the best!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I'll go pack up this dish for Miss Kamisato. Please make your way back to the restaurant whenever you're ready, the food will be waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: You could have sold that recipe for a high price, but you selflessly gave it away for free...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...You're a wonderful person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aw shucks, Ayaka...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I mean it... I admire you a lot, and I'm so proud to be friends with someone of such fine character.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Well, you should probably write down the recipe now, no?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah, {NICKNAME}, let's make sure we include all the details and then give it to Miss Kiminami!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, pizza! Start with the basic ingredients.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Correctamundo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, now to add the next couple of ingredients!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm, yep! That's right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now to add the cooking instructions... "Place onto oven rack at high heat and cook till golden brown."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, it's done!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Long may our reputations and our recipes precede us, wherever we go in Inazuma!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I have no doubt that they will. This dish is exquisite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool, then let's get this recipe to Miss Kiminami, pronto!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xiangling sure left a deep impression on you, huh...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh? Who's Xiangling?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A friend of ours who's a really talented chef, though she has some strange tastes... Still, she's one of Paimon's favorites!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? Okay, well, you're the chef...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Your garment is ready, Miss Kamisato. I've folded and packaged it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Oh, and the other item we discussed — that's ready too!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: No, thank you! It is a beautiful piece of clothing, and it was a pleasure to work on. See you again next time!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, I have a gift for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Looks super fancy! Is that for wearing in your hair?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's a hairpin in the style of a white heron. As well as a hair accessory, you can also use it as an ornament.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I couldn't ask for your help and offer nothing at all in return, so this is my gift to you.

choices.text: It's a beautiful gift, thank you very much.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I'm glad you like it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of white herons, that's what your title means, doesn't it? Shirasagi Himegimi. So this gift is like a little piece of yourself. It's just as elegant and beautiful as you are.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hehe, you flatter me, Paimon. If this gift reminds you of me, that is all I could ask for.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hee-hee, it definitely will.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, well, now we've got what we came for, we can set off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Time to go meet Tsubaki!

choices.text: I will take very good care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Here it is!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Wowee, this is so exciting! I want to make it right away.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, please accept my sincerest apologies for delaying your meal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, no problem! Food always tastes better when you've worked up an appetite.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Alright, let's dig in before it gets cold.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Well, what do you think? Is Inazuman cuisine to your liking?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's amazing! Paimon loved this one... Oh! A—And especially that one over there...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Haha, good. I'm relieved.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Um... When I was attempting to cook earlier on, did you... chat with the owner at all?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: And did she, uh... say anything about me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She did, but don't worry, she's just happy for you is all.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: She's... happy for me?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh... then... she must have told you. D—Did she, um...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: *sigh* What does it matter... I know just as well as anybody else that I've got no friends...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, it's not you, most people just haven't had the chance to talk to you one-on-one before.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Thank you for your comforting words, Paimon.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: It's all true, though. I just... don't have very many friends.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Most of the time I'm either accompanied by family or staff. So everyone must have found it quite a surprise to see me taking you out for a meal...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! You've got at least two friends right here!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Aw...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Thank you... that makes me so happy!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ahem, excuse me... I—I'm forgetting myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey now, expressing your feelings is the right thing to do. Keeping them locked away inside isn't gonna do you any good, now is it?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I agree! So...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I just want to say how happy I feel... that you both see me as a true friend.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course we do. That's always been our style — if someone's nice to us, we're nice to them, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Friendship can go a long way! Take your mom for example — she wrote about Tsubaki in her notebook, and now it's made you want to find them, too.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Yes! I think friendship is an extremely precious thing, and ours is one that I will always treasure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, while we're on the topic though — who is this Tsubaki person, anyway?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Well, I think I have an idea, but it's just speculative at this point.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm all ears.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I think that Tsubaki... might be a fox envoy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A fox envoy?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Yes. That's what I think.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Even I, my mother's own daughter, had never even heard of this friend before. It just seems so mysterious. So I think it must be someone with transcendent abilities who doesn't show themselves very often.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: And fox envoys are nothing new. Stories have been told about them in Inazuma since ancient times.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: You must have met Guuji Yae before? Well, she's a fox envoy!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: That got me thinking, maybe there are fox envoys out there in Inazuma that people just don't know about... and maybe Tsubaki is one of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, so Inazuma also has supernatural beings?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Uh, when you say "also"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, before Inazuma we spent some time in Liyue. They have lots of supernatural beings there, like the adepti.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All kinds of them, too... Up in the sky, down below the ground, in the water...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Really... I have come across such things being asserted in books, but to hear someone talk about it from firsthand experience is extremely surprising.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: So, Liyue lives up to its reputation... Its culture has a long history and gives rise to the most beautiful legends. Quite captivating.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You should come visit Liyue with us some time. The best part is... they have loads and loads of delicious delicacies!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Really? I would love that!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Speaking of delicacies — Traveler, Paimon, have you eaten your fill?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon has!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Excellent, then let's collect the kimono. Then we can pay a visit to my mother's mysterious and transcendent friend...

choices.text: You've got a friend in me.
It was nice to try something new.

talks.objective: Return to Ogura Textiles & Kimonos to collect the goods

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hey! Have you written out the recipe?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Is the pizza ready?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: The garment will be ready later. Why not look around the area in the meantime?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hi Traveler — is everything okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I don't see Ayaka looking so flustered very often... Whatever it is, it must be a tricky situation.
